v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Cantáte * Dómino et benedícite nómini eius.
text.en: Sing ye * to the Lord and bless his name.
The salvation of my countenance * and my God.

text.la: Illúmina, Dómine, * vultum tuum super nos.
text.en: May the Lord shine the light * of his countenance upon us.

text.la: Exaltáte * Regem sæculórum in opéribus vestris.
text.en: Give ye glory to him * in your works.

text.la: Laudáte * nomen Dómini, qui statis in domo Dómini.
text.en: Praise * the name of the Lord, ye who stand in the house of the Lord.

text.la: Beátus vir, qui invéntus est sine mácula, et qui post aurum non ábiit, nec sperávit in pecúnia et thesáuris. Quis est hic, et laudábimus eum? fecit enim mirabília in vita sua.
text.en: Blessed is the rich man that is found without blemish: and that hath not gone after gold, nor put his trust in money nor in treasures. Who is he, and we will praise him? for he hath done wonderful things in his life.

v.la: Iustum dedúxit Dóminus per vias rectas.
v.en: The Lord guided the just in right paths.

r.en: And showed him the kingdom of God.

text.la: Euge, serve bone * et fidélis, quia in pauca fuísti fidélis, supra multa te constítuam, intra in gáudium Dómini tui.
text.en: Well done, thou good and faithful servant; * thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things; enter thou into the joy of thy Lord.

text.la: Deus, misericordiárum pater, per mérita et intercessiónem beáti Hierónymi, quem órphanis adiutórem et patrem esse voluísti: concéde; ut spíritum adoptiónis, quo fílii tui nominámur et sumus, fidéliter custodiámus.
text.en: O God, the Father of mercies, Who wast pleased that blessed Jerome should be an helper and a father to the fatherless, grant unto us for his sake and at his prayers, the grace ever to hold fast to the spirit of adoption, whereby we cry to thee, Father, and are called and are thy sons.

text.la: Símile est regnum cælórum hómini negotiatóri quærénti bonas margarítas: invénta una pretiósa, dedit ómnia sua, et comparávit eam.
text.en: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchantman seeking goodly pearls, who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

v.la: Diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis.
v.en: Grace is poured into thy lips.

r.la: Proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum.
r.en: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

text.la: Indulgéntiam nobis, quǽsumus, Dómine, beáta Margaríta Virgo et Martyr implóret: quæ tibi grata semper éxstitit, et mérito castitátis, et tuæ professióne virtútis.
text.en: O Lord, we pray thee, that thy blessed handmaiden and witness Margaret in whom Thou hast ever been well pleased, because of her worthy maidenhood and her mighty showing-forth of thy power, may entreat thy pardon on our behalf.
